column1: # The DL queries of rdf-array's examples/fhir (README §5, FhirReasoning.java), tab-separated from

fhir:Observation and fhir:code some (sct:Inflammatory_disorder-disorder and sct:role_group-attr some (sct:Associated_morphology-attr some sct:Inflammatory_morphology-morph and sct:Finding_site-attr some sct:Structure_of_musculoskeletal_system-body))
fhir:Observation and fhir:code some (fhir:coding some (ra:member some :Coding-in-ICD-10))
fhir:Observation and fhir:code some (fhir:coding some (ra:member some :Coding-of-icd10-M05.9))
fhir:Patient and inverse fhir:l some (inverse fhir:subject some :Observation-of-Seronegative_rheumatoid_arthritis)
fhir:Observation and fhir:code some (fhir:coding some (ra:first some :Coding-in-SNOMED))
fhir:Observation and fhir:code some (fhir:coding some (ra:last some :Coding-in-SNOMED))
fhir:Observation and fhir:code some (fhir:coding some (ra:length value 1))
fhir:Observation and fhir:component some (ra:member some (fhir:value some (fhir:value some (fhir:v some xsd:decimal[>= 160]))))
fhir:Patient and fhir:name some (ra:member some (fhir:given some (ra:length some xsd:integer[>= 2])))
fhir:Observation and fhir:code some (fhir:coding some ra:EmptySequence)
